summary: NewcelX Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 1, 2026, reporting a press release about a successful FDA Pre-IND meeting for NCEL-101, a stem-cell-derived islet cell therapy for type 1 diabetes. The FDA provided alignment on CMC and preclinical programs, allowing the company to proceed toward IND-enabling activities. There are no deal terms disclosed. This is a routine regulatory milestone update with no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or capital return.
